title: Three Annual Feasts

questions.question: In which month is the Passover observed?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:1 (ESV): "Observe the month of Abib and keep the Passover..."

questions.question: What kind of bread is eaten for seven days during Passover?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:3 (ESV): "...seven days you shall eat it with unleavened bread, the bread of affliction..."

questions.question: Three times a year all males shall appear before the Lord. Which feasts are these?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:16 (ESV): "Three times a year all your males shall appear... at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Booths."

questions.question: How long is the Feast of Booths?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:13 (ESV): "You shall keep the Feast of Booths seven days..."

questions.question: What is forbidden to be planted near the altar?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:21 (ESV): "You shall not plant any tree as an Asherah beside the altar of the Lord..."

questions.question: How should the judges judge?
options: With righteous judgment; no partiality or bribes
questions.correctAnswer: With righteous judgment; no partiality or bribes
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:18–19 (ESV): "...they shall judge the people with righteous judgment. You shall not pervert justice..."

questions.question: What blinds the eyes of the wise?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:19 (ESV): "...for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise..."

questions.question: How much should one give at the feasts?
options: As he is able, according to the blessing of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: As he is able, according to the blessing of the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:17 (ESV): "Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the Lord..."

questions.question: When does the Feast of Weeks begin?
options: Seven weeks from the time the sickle is put to the standing grain
questions.correctAnswer: Seven weeks from the time the sickle is put to the standing grain
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:9 (ESV): "You shall count seven weeks. Begin to count... from the time the sickle is first put to the standing grain."

questions.question: What is the "Feast of Booths" also associated with?
options: Gathering in produce from threshing floor and winepress
questions.correctAnswer: Gathering in produce from threshing floor and winepress
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:13 (ESV): "...when you have gathered in the produce from your threshing floor and your winepress."

questions.question: Why sacrifice the Passover in the evening at sunset?
options: Because it is the time they came out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Because it is the time they came out of Egypt
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:6 (ESV): "...in the evening at sunset, at the time you came out of Egypt."

questions.question: What should not be set up which the Lord hates?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:22 (ESV): "and you shall not set up a pillar, which the Lord your God hates."

questions.question: Regarding justice, what is emphasized in verse 20?
options: Justice, and only justice, you shall follow
questions.correctAnswer: Justice, and only justice, you shall follow
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:20 (ESV): "Justice, and only justice, you shall follow, that you may live..."

questions.question: Where should the flesh of the Passover be cooked?
options: Roast/cook it at the place the Lord chooses
questions.correctAnswer: Roast/cook it at the place the Lord chooses
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:7 (ESV): "And you shall cook it and eat it at the place that the Lord your God will choose..."

questions.question: How many days is no leaven to be seen in the territory?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 16:4 (ESV): "No leaven shall be seen with you in all your territory for seven days..."

key_verse_text: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD your God that he has given you. (ESV)
